1.zh: 先知哈巴谷所得的默示。
1.en: The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.

1.zh: 他说：耶和华啊！我呼求你， 你不应允，要到几时呢？ 我因强暴哀求你，你还不拯救。
1.en: LORD, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?

1.zh: 你为何使我看见罪孽？ 你为何看着奸恶[而不理]呢？ 毁灭和强暴在我面前， 又起了争端和相斗的事。
1.en: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.

1.zh: 因此律法放松， 公理也不显明； 恶人围困义人， 所以公理显然颠倒。
1.en: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.

1.zh: [耶和华说]：你们要向列国中观看， 大大惊奇； 因为在你们的时候，我行一件事， 虽有人告诉你们，你们总是不信。
1.en: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.

1.zh: 我必兴起迦勒底人， 就是那残忍暴躁之民，通行遍地， 占据那不属自己的住处。
1.en: For, behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation who march through the width of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.

1.zh: 他威武可畏， 判断和势力都任意发出。
1.en: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.

1.zh: 他的马比豹更快， 比晚上的豺狼更猛。 马兵踊跃争先， 都从远方而来； 他们飞跑如鹰抓食，
1.en: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.

1.zh: 都为行强暴而来， 定住脸面向前， 将掳掠的人聚集，多如尘沙。
1.en: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face forward. They gather prisoners like sand.

1.zh: 他们讥诮君王，笑话首领， 嗤笑一切保障，筑垒攻取。
1.en: Yes, they scoff at kings, and princes are a derision to them. They laugh at every stronghold, for they build up an earthen ramp and take it.

1.zh: 他以自己的势力为神， 像风猛然扫过，显为有罪。
1.en: Then they sweep by like the wind and go on. They are indeed guilty, whose strength is their god.”

1.zh: 耶和华—我的　神，我的圣者啊， 你不是从亘古而有吗？ 我们必不致死。 耶和华啊，你派定他为要刑罚人； 磐石啊，你设立他为要惩治人。
1.en: Aren’t you from everlasting, LORD my God, my Holy One? We will not die. LORD, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.

1.zh: 你眼目清洁， 不看邪僻，不看奸恶； 行诡诈的，你为何看着不理呢？ 恶人吞灭比自己公义的， 你为何静默不语呢？
1.en: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,

1.zh: 你为何使人如海中的鱼， 又如没有管辖的爬物呢？
1.en: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them?

1.zh: 他用钩钩住，用网捕获， 用拉网聚集他们； 因此，他欢喜快乐，
1.en: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.

1.zh: 就向网献祭，向网烧香， 因他由此得肥美的分和富裕的食物。
1.en: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious and his food is good.

1.zh: 他岂可屡次倒空网罗， 将列国的人时常杀戮，毫不顾惜呢？
1.en: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?

2.zh: 我要站在守望所， 立在望楼上观看， 看耶和华对我说什么话， 我可用什么话向他诉冤。
2.en: I will stand at my watch and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.

2.zh: 他对我说：将这默示明明地写在版上， 使读的人容易读。
2.en: The LORD answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.

2.zh: 因为这默示有一定的日期， 快要应验，并不虚谎。 虽然迟延，还要等候； 因为必然临到，不再迟延。
2.en: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.

2.zh: 迦勒底人自高自大，心不正直； 惟义人因信得生。
2.en: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.

2.zh: 迦勒底人因酒诡诈，狂傲， 不住在家中， 扩充心欲，好像阴间。 他如死不能知足， 聚集万国，堆积万民都归自己。
2.en: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous: an arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol; he is like death and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations and heaps to himself all peoples.

2.zh: 这些国的民岂不都要提起诗歌并俗语讥刺他说： 祸哉！迦勒底人，你增添不属自己的财物， 多多取人的当头，要到几时为止呢？
2.en: Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’

2.zh: 咬伤你的岂不忽然起来， 扰害你的岂不兴起， 你就作他们的掳物吗？
2.en: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?

2.zh: 因你抢夺许多的国，杀人流血， 向国内的城并城中一切居民施行强暴， 所以各国剩下的民都必抢夺你。
2.en: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.

2.zh: 为本家积蓄不义之财、 在高处搭窝、指望免灾的有祸了！
2.en: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!

2.zh: 你图谋剪除多国的民，犯了罪， 使你的家蒙羞，自害己命。
2.en: You have devised shame to your house by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.

2.zh: 墙里的石头必呼叫； 房内的栋梁必应声。
2.en: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.

2.zh: 以人血建城、 以罪孽立邑的有祸了！
2.en: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!

2.zh: 众民所劳碌得来的被火焚烧， 列国由劳乏而得的归于虚空， 不都是出于万军之耶和华吗？
2.en: Behold, isn’t it from the LORD of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?

2.zh: 认识耶和华荣耀的知识要充满遍地， 好像水充满洋海一般。
2.en: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the LORD’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.

2.zh: 给人[酒]喝、又加上毒物、 使他喝醉、好看见他下体的有祸了！
2.en: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!

2.zh: 你满受羞辱，不得荣耀； 你也喝吧，显出是未受割礼的！ 耶和华右手的杯必传到你那里； 你的荣耀就变为大大地羞辱。
2.en: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink and be exposed! The cup of the LORD’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

2.zh: 你向黎巴嫩行强暴与残害 惊吓野兽的事必遮盖你； 因你杀人流血， 向国内的城并城中一切居民施行强暴。
2.en: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals will terrify you, because of men’s blood and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.

2.zh: 雕刻的偶像，人将它刻出来， 有什么益处呢？ 铸造的偶像就是虚谎的师傅。 制造者倚靠这哑巴偶像有什么益处呢？
2.en: “What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he who fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?

2.zh: 对木偶说：醒起！ 对哑巴石像说：起来！那人有祸了！ 这个还能教训人吗？ 看哪，是包裹金银的，其中毫无气息。
2.en: Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.

2.zh: 惟耶和华在他的圣殿中； 全地的人都当在他面前肃敬静默。
2.en: But the LORD is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”

3.zh: 先知哈巴谷的祷告，调用流离歌。
3.en: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.

3.zh: 耶和华啊，我听见你的名声就惧怕。 耶和华啊，求你在这些年间复兴你的作为， 在这些年间显明出来； 在发怒的时候以怜悯为念。
3.en: LORD, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, LORD. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In the middle of the years make it known. In wrath, you remember mercy.

3.zh: 神从提幔而来； 圣者从巴兰山临到。 （细拉） 他的荣光遮蔽诸天； 颂赞充满大地。
3.en: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.

3.zh: 他的辉煌如同日光； 从他手里[射出]光线， 在其中藏着他的能力。
3.en: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.

3.zh: 在他前面有瘟疫流行； 在他脚下有热症发出。
3.en: Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.

3.zh: 他站立，量了大地， 观看，赶散万民。 永久的山崩裂； 长存的岭塌陷； 他的作为与古时一样。
3.en: He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.

3.zh: 我见古珊的帐棚遭难， 米甸的幔子战兢。
3.en: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.

3.zh: 耶和华啊，你乘在马上， 坐在得胜的车上， 岂是不喜悦江河、 向江河发怒气、 向洋海发愤恨吗？
3.en: Was the LORD displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode on your horses, on your chariots of salvation?

3.zh: 你的弓全然显露， 向众支派所起的誓都是[可信的]。 （细拉） 你以江河分开大地。
3.en: You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.

3.zh: 山岭见你，无不战惧； 大水泛滥过去， 深渊发声，汹涌翻腾。
3.en: The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.

3.zh: 因你的箭射出发光， 你的枪闪出光耀， 日月都在本宫停住。
3.en: The sun and moon stood still in the sky at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.

3.zh: 你发忿恨通行大地， 发怒气责打列国，如同打粮。
3.en: You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger.

3.zh: 你出来要拯救你的百姓， 拯救你的受膏者， 打破恶人家长的头， 露出他的脚，直到颈项。 （细拉）
3.en: You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped them head to foot. Selah.

3.zh: 你用[敌人的]戈矛刺透他战士的头； 他们来如旋风，要将我们分散。 他们所喜爱的是暗中吞吃贫民。
3.en: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.

3.zh: 你乘马践踏红海， 就是践踏汹涌的大水。
3.en: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.

3.zh: 我听见[耶和华的]声音， 身体战兢，嘴唇发颤， 骨中朽烂； 我在所立之处战兢。 我只可安静等候灾难之日临到， 犯境之民上来。
3.en: I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.

3.zh: 虽然无花果树不发旺， 葡萄树不结果， 橄榄树也不效力， 田地不出粮食， 圈中绝了羊， 棚内也没有牛；
3.en: For even though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines, the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food, the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls,

3.zh: 然而，我要因耶和华欢欣， 因救我的　神喜乐。
3.en: yet I will rejoice in the LORD. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!

3.zh: 主耶和华是我的力量； 他使我的脚快如母鹿的[蹄]， 又使我稳行在高处。 这歌交与伶长，用丝弦的乐器。
3.en: GOD, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.
